content: Ligand 2 is the charged azetidine-piperazinium I have already seen: QED 0.634, SA 3.80, no aromatic rings, jnk3 zero. Crossing it in would only import bad SA. Ligand 1 is the pyrazolyl-acetamide host I have used twice before, at the same anchor (cut non-ring CH2-N bond 16-17 to drop the tetrahydroisoquinoline), which lets me run a controlled comparison. Earlier I put a bare 2-aminopyrimidin-4-yl there. The open question is whether a single small heteroaryl is enough for a fingerprint-based activity model, or whether it needs a larger, more complete pharmacophore. So this time I graft the full 4-(2-aminopyrimidin-4-yl)anilino unit instead: aryl-NH linker plus biaryl aminopyrimidine, which reproduces the whole hinge-binder-plus-aniline arrangement of real anilinopyrimidine kinase inhibitors rather than just its tip. MW ~413, still well inside the 700 ceiling, and it is the same host and same attachment point as the small-graft version, so the difference in outcome is attributable to graft size alone.
